headline: 3 stories worth your time — mostly pricing & access. Start with: Workday and Zuora Unite to Simplify AI-Driven Pricing for Businesses

items.title: Workday and Zuora Unite to Simplify AI-Driven Pricing for Businesses
items.summary: Discover how the partnership between Workday and Zuora is transforming pricing strategies for businesses through AI-driven solutions. Learn about the benefits, features, and impact of this innovative collaboration on your pricing processes.
items.whyItMatters: This moves your cost base. Even small per-seat changes compound when you are paying out of revenue rather than a budget line.
actions: Compare against what you currently pay for the same job and reprice if the gap is material.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Background reading — no action needed today, but worth knowing.

items.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
items.summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Skim it, then decide in one minute whether it changes anything you do this week.
